title: LLM Serving Market
blurb: The LLM serving market at level 0, with its routed interface driven by an observed series: OpenRouter's rankings-daily, vintage 2026-10-10, 2025-01 to 2026-10, monthly. The routed workload is every token OpenRouter routed that month per day, and the Router's split is the tokens that went to closed-weight models against those that went to open-weight ones, each model classified from its own card or lab page (85% of routed tokens classified; stealth models and the long tail below the top 50 are counted in the workload but in neither weight, so the split shown is the high end of the open share's range). Each serving subsystem turns compute into served tokens, every Gtok of work dissipated as heat; zoom into a subsystem for its roster, or double-click to enter. The self-hosted workload has no public sensor and stays at the model's declared placeholder, grounded unknown. Rankings data by OpenRouter, CC BY 4.0.
